arabic text: ZULMO SITAM KI INTEHA HAI YE KARBALA HAI\nKAHIN PE SAR HAI KAHIN RIDA HAI\nYE KARBALA HAI
english translation text: This is the very limit of oppression and cruelty—this is Karbala.\nHere lies a severed head, there lies a stolen veil;\nthis is Karbala.

arabic text:
GHAZI NAHIN HAI AKBAR NAHIN HAI
QASIM NAHIN HAI ASGHAR NAHIN HAI
AUR SHAH KA LASHA TANHA PARA HAI
YE KARBALA HAI
english translation text:
There is no Ghazi, no Akbar,
no Qasim, no Asghar;
and the King's body lies alone—
this is Karbala.

arabic text:
KARKE DAFAN MASUME AGHAR
SHABBIR ROYE NANNI QABAR PAR
ASGHAR KE KHUN SE CHEHRA BHARA HAI
YE KARBALA HAI
english translation text:
After burying the innocent Asghar,
Shabbir wept beside the tiny grave;
his face was covered in Asghar's blood—
this is Karbala.

arabic text:
MAQTAL ME HAI JO FAKHRE YUSUF
HAM SHAKLE AHMAD HAI NAAM AKBAR
SEENE ME USKE TOOTI SINA HAI
YE KARBALA HAI
english translation text:
In the battlefield lies one who was the pride of Yusuf,
the likeness of Ahmad, whose name was Akbar;
a broken spear remains within his chest—
this is Karbala.

arabic text:
DONO JAHAAN MUTHI ME JISKE
MAQTAL ME PYASA SHABBIR HAI WO
HAL MIN KI TANHA DETA SADA HAI
YE KARBALA HAI
english translation text:
He in whose grasp are both worlds
is thirsty in the battlefield—Shabbir;
alone, he gives the call of 'Hal min'—
this is Karbala.

arabic text:
ISLAM KI KHATIR LUTA HAI
JOHAR MUHAMMAD KA HAI GHARANA
AB SHAAM LUT NE GHAR YE CHALA HAI
YE KARBALA HAI
english translation text:
For Islam, the entire household of Muhammad
was sacrificed, O Johar;
and now this plundered family departs for Shaam—
this is Karbala.
